set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- A deliberate decision is recorded on depending on core Shape or retaining an equivalent checked packed shape.
- Rank zero, zero extents, scalar selection, zero-length narrow, negative axes, negative indices, slicing, selection, reversal, and permutation have specified behavior.
- Naming distinguishes axis-preserving slice from axis-dropping select.
- Any divergence from core has a documented storage-specific reason.
- Checked constructors and throwing conveniences follow the repository error philosophy.
- Model tests compare packed views with an unpacked Vector oracle.
set.title: Align packed shape and indexing algebra with core
